scripts.api-build-spec: pnpm run update-paths-and-schemas && pnpm run tsc && node ./build/checkTagsUsage.js && node ./build/checkModelsReferences.js && node ./build/buildApiSpec.js && swagger-cli validate docs/build/api-docs-output.yaml
scripts.api-convert-spec-to-docs-json: pnpm run api-convert-spec-to-json && pnpm run resolve-descriptions-in-json-spec
scripts.api-docs: pnpm run api-build-spec && pnpm run api-convert-spec-to-dredd && pnpm run api-docs-export-page && pnpm run api-test
scripts.api-docs-export-page: redoc-cli build docs/build/api-docs-output.yaml --title 'Devopness API Docs' --output public/index.html -t docs/template.hbs
scripts.api-docs-make-description-files: for endpoint in $(find docs/spec/auto-generated/endpoints -type f); do touch -a docs/spec/descriptions/$(basename ${endpoint%%.yaml}).md; done
scripts.api-docs-serve: pnpm run api-build-spec && redoc-cli serve docs/build/api-docs-output.yaml --port 9090 --title 'Devopness API Docs - Local' -t docs/template.hbs
scripts.api-test: pnpm run tsc && pnpm run test && pnpm run remove-descriptions && dredd
scripts.build: pnpm run api-docs && pnpm run ensure_index_file_is_on_size_limit
